Chapter 6535: Destruction

Chapter 6535: Destruction

Firmament Eagle Monarch’s appearance startled many big shots, especially the stronger ones.

His talent was well known during his era, rumored to be someone capable of surpassing North Kun God on the heaven-slayer path. Why was he a corpse now?

“He’s dead.” A primal ancestor activated their heavenly gaze.

Although the aura of the eagle and his divinity remained, the death miasma had seeped into the bones. The lack of life made him resemble a puppet. Nevertheless, his cultivation remained.

The eagle soared into the air and glided downward, ready to devour the legion.

“I got this.” Summit Primal Ancestor leaped into the air and released his oceanic primal aura.

A divine mountain emerged from this expanse and blocked the incoming eagle’s sharp claws. The dao laws spinning around the mountain protected it from the devastating strike.

Meanwhile, powerful corpses came out from the more conspicuous tombs. They included progenitors from the old days and modern primal ancestors and heaven-slayers.

On the other side, a Buddha with nine arms and three heads appeared with a scripture behind him. When the pages turned, the Buddhist dao engulfed Corpse Wasteland.

As he chanted, this dao rushed toward the legion. Each rune was as large as a mountain, falling like countless meteors.

“Three-headed Ascetic!” The few who recognized him shouted.

He was once the strongest in Lankavatara Temple. He successfully endured a tribulation but disappeared later on.

Greatbones God swung his golden sword. Its slight movement emitted incredible sword energy, wiping out the runes.

As for Skynet Demoness, she took the initiative and delivered a palm strike against a monumental tomb.

When it broke down, black energy billowed forth. A ghastly banner flew out, seemingly wanting to coil around the battlefield and refine everything within.

“Malevolent Banner Lord!” A heaven-slayer recognized the banner. Its master was an ancient existence who found a fortune in a redemption ground, granting him a ghastly power.

When he was alive, he refined numerous emperors and desolate gods, turning some of them into puppets for entertainment. Some heaven-slayers and primal ancestors feared him enough to stay away. Just like the others, he also disappeared without warning.

Skynet Demoness was just as strong and summoned auspicious clouds to prevent the banner from expanding. As she raised her hand, she seemed to be raising the whole sky.

“Bam!” The banner was pushed into space.

“Show yourselves!” Other primal ancestors and heaven-slayers destroyed the tombs, revealing mighty corpses.

“Butterfly Matron, Spirit Tortoise, Archery Sovereign....” Spectators became started.

“I thought they died in battle long ago, why are they here?” Someone whispered.

“This force is catching up to the two heavens.” A desolate god said.

The dead and missing cultivators - all with different circumstances - appeared in Corpse Wasteland.

“Was Bao Pu collecting and burying corpses here?” An emperor speculated.

Numerous small battles started between the top cultivators and the corpses, destroying the fabric of reality and striking down stars.

Life and Death Heaven came prepared, intending to destroy all the corpses.

“Screech!” Skyfire Phoenix and the legion activated their fiery formation, engulfing the horde of corpses and turning them into ashes.

The commanders also had the upper hand, fully incinerating the corpses to prevent them from rising again.

“They want to erase Corspse Wasteland.” A commenter said while looking at the devastation.
